title: Florida Business Registry Quarterly Active Entities
description: Governed Florida Department of State quarterly active-entity layer using privacy-minimized business identity, filing-profile, and reported principal-address fields, with ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
coverage_claim: Entities marked A in the official Florida quarterly corporate archive as of the archive generation time; source membership is not proof of current operation, legality, licensure, public access, or a physical business site.
identity_rule: Each unique Florida corporate document number becomes one provisional organization candidate. Reported principal addresses remain organization assertions and never create physical sites or establishments.
